member.name: T:Durable.MySql.MySqlDataTypeConverter
member.summary: MySQL value conversion. MySqlConnector handles most types natively; values are stored as UTC DATETIME values because MySQL has no offset-aware type, GUIDs are stored as 36-character strings, and values are stored as BIGINT ticks so durations beyond MySQL's TIME range round-trip. Thread safety: stateless; safe for concurrent use.
